authorization_basis: The calibration run completed under v0.13.3 and sealed the terminal retire_generator decision. This separate record does not claim preregistration, pre-exposure freezing, or authority to reopen that retired program.
never_claim: generalization beyond this fixed synthetic suite
that any single harness mechanism caused the effect
within-instance repeatability beyond the two executed trials

not_a_confirmatory_result.reason: The governing calibration protocol 1.6.0 set per_condition_counts_or_directions_may_be_read=false and the generator version was terminally retired by its calibration gate. This record was created after that terminal decision, is retrospective, and cannot support the preregistered confirmatory claim.

purpose: Specify how a paired harness_full versus native_tools contrast may be recovered from already executed calibration attempts at zero additional inference cost, solely as retrospective context for the focused follow-up.

retrospective_reporting_constraints.difficulty_context_must_be_disclosed: 8 of 11 families fell outside the 10..22 calibration band. This constrains interpretability and sensitivity, but does not determine the effect direction or mathematically require attenuation.
retrospective_reporting_constraints.interval_contains_zero: inconclusive retrospective result; no directional statement
retrospective_reporting_constraints.interval_excludes_zero_above: harness_full measured higher than native_tools on this fixed synthetic suite; report the estimate and interval only as retrospective exploratory context
retrospective_reporting_constraints.interval_excludes_zero_below: native_tools measured higher than harness_full on this fixed synthetic suite; report the estimate and interval only as retrospective exploratory context
retrospective_reporting_constraints.reference_threshold: abs(Delta) >= 0.12 is reported for comparability with the confirmatory contract but does not constitute a confirmatory claim

statistics.all_family_statistic: equal-family mean of the 11 family effects
statistics.arithmetic: exact rational (fractions.Fraction); no floating point in the point estimate
statistics.cluster_difference: harness_full cluster value minus native_tools cluster value
statistics.condition_cluster_value: mean of the two binary strict_success trials for that condition and cluster
descriptive_only: evidence-derived model-call counts and generated-token exact-or-bounds only when a separately sealed aggregate extractor supplies them
equal-family mean over the in-band subset cal_freeslot, pptx_basic, remind_msg
arithmetic measurable-effect bound 2*min(c, 1-c) per family from the sealed condition-combined rate c
statistics.family_effect: arithmetic mean of the 8 cluster differences in that family

interval.exact_uniformity: 8 divides 2^256 exactly, so modulo reduction is exactly uniform and no rejection sampling is required
interval.resampling: 8 clusters drawn with replacement within each family, independently per family

statistics.sign_flip_diagnostic: Use the 88 two-trial instance-cluster differences, retain each nonzero absolute magnitude, and compute the exact two-sided sign-flip distribution by dynamic programming. The diagnostic cannot alter any claim.
statistics.subset_selection_criterion: the calibration band 10..22 inclusive, frozen in protocol 1.6.0 before any data existed, applied to condition-combined totals only

timing_measurement.allowed_replacement: A separately recorded block-boundary elapsed time may be reported for a later focused follow-up, with its measurement boundary stated.
timing_measurement.reason: The completed calibration attempt records carry zero wall_time_ms and model_time_ms values. This record must not report fabricated or imputed per-condition timing.
